research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Apiiro is researching systems for augmenting automated runtime API testing with static analysis to enrich security findings, and mapping source code components and risks to runtime cloud resources. It develops methods for efficient malicious code detection using large language models, detecting risky feature requests before implementation, and unifying risks and remediations across application and infrastructure code, covering API security, cloud risk mapping, code analysis, and feature governance.

press_references.value: Apiiro Unveils AI-Powered Software Graph Visualization to Continuously Uncover Risks and Transform Threat Modeling

product_launches.description: Apiiro has launched Software Graph Visualization, an AI-powered feature that provides real-time, interactive mapping of software architectures to help security teams continuously uncover risks and transform threat modeling. The tool replaces manual self-attestation with autonomous, contextual insights, enabling proactive risk assessment, pen-test scoping, change impact analysis, privacy review, blast radius analysis, and vulnerability management.

overview_description.description:
Apiiro enables security and development teams to proactively remediate risk before releasing to the cloud. Apiiro develops the industry's first Code Risk Platform™ to aid application and infrastructure stakeholders to accelerate delivery by automatically reducing product risk with every material change before it is shipped to production.

Apiiro empowers security and development teams with complete visibility and actionable context - so they can proactively fix risks across the software supply chain.
